Implemented `solve(payload, config)` in `/Volumes/Models/ds4/.workspaces/server-agent-day-20261004/fresh32-visible/bucket/solution.py`.

It uses exact integer arithmetic, starts with `tokens = capacity` at time 0, refills before every event using the elapsed time since the previous event timestamp, caps at capacity, advances the timestamp, accepts zero-cost events even at zero tokens, rejects oversized costs without spending tokens, and returns the required `accepted`, `rejected`, `remaining`, and `tokens` fields without mutating the inputs.
